title: Dutch-Style Rice Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful side dish, perfect for accompanying your favorite Dutch meals. Velvety rice pilaf is a comforting and delicious addition to any meal.

ingredients.name: dutch pilaf spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most international grocery stores

instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the pilaf spice mix and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the chicken broth and water (if using), and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the grated ginger (if using).
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
